posts.cooked: Guys, I’ve got it, this is how we save Sentinels. We get the Volkswagen Motor Corp to buy the IP off Flat River, and then publish a new comic that retells the story of Omnitron X being destroyed and rebuilt into Omniton-U, and in the middle of that process she creates a super overpowered version that time travels everywhere and solves all the problems, and he’s called Omniton-VW. But alas, his perfect German engineering was just too pure for this world, and all the Volkswagen commercials disguised as comics end up retconned out of continuity as VW returns to the exact moment of creation, sacrifices himself for the sins of robot kind, and is replaced by O-U so the story as we know it can resume.
